## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (64%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive (25%) and in situ (8%) carcinoma remain in the conformal set on this simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 64%, Invasive 25%, InSitu 8%, Normal 3% (ECE 5%) | Favors benign, sizable invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (alpha 10%, test coverage 90%, n=132) | Cannot exclude in situ or invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 94% reliability, 76th percentile OOD, 12/12 tiles kept [F6] (AUROC 70%) | Image quality typical, unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Models agree on top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%) [F5]; top match InSitu (85% similarity) | Mixed neighbors weaken benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Strongest benign score (-0.87) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest invasive score (+0.81) [F3], but 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Credible invasive score (+0.58) [F4]; 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Text-only benign score (-0.29), caption-inconsistent; 18/20 AI spot-check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Faithfulness unproven (95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); top drivers normal lobules and mitoses are unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasive or in situ carcinoma in high-risk regions 4 and 7–11 is diluted by benign regions 0–3.
- Top neighbor BACH_0339 is InSitu (85% similarity); drafted deeper levels may uncover atypia or DCIS (stains blocked).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 11**: Highest heatmap risk (100%); inspect for stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism.
2. **Regions 4, 7, 8, 9**: High heatmap risk (52%–96%) with validated nuclear pleomorphism in 8, 9.
3. **Regions 4, 7–11**: Check called inferior (538 um), lateral (323 um), medial (215 um) margins [F7]; deeper levels drafted.
